article.title: Sierra、Meta推Personal Agent Protocol，規範AI代理人存取企業服務
article.summary:
企業AI新創Sierra周二（10/6）宣布，正與Meta及Walmart、Shopify、Stripe等業者共同開發Personal Agent Protocol，建立個人AI代理人存取企業網站、API及服務的開放標準。
隨著個人AI代理人開始替使用者購物、訂票、預約及處理客服需求，企業也面臨新的存取問題。目前許多代理人仍像真人一樣操作網站或App，透過載入頁面、點擊按鈕及填寫表單完成任務，但企業往往無法清楚判斷來訪者是真人、受使用者授權的AI代理人，還是未經許可的自動化程式，也難以掌握代理人究竟獲得哪些權限。

article.title: 740M模型實現裝置端多模態搜尋，Google EmbeddingGemma 2支援文字與影音檢索
article.summary: Google推出EmbeddingGemma 2多模態嵌入模型，以740M參數處理文字、程式碼、圖片、影片與音訊，並可直接部署在手機、筆電等裝置。開發者可用文字搜尋圖片或影片片段，也能拿一段音訊尋找內容相近的影音，相關資料不必上傳雲端處理。

article.title: ChatGPT users, your AI-written text will soon carry a hidden watermark
article.summary: Credit: Edgar Cervantes / Android Authority TL;DR ChatGPT-generated text will soon carry an invisible watermark, starting in Europe. OpenAI’s detector can identify the watermark, but edits and shorter text can make detection harder. If you use ChatGPT to write, your AI-generated text could soon be identifiable as such. For years, AI tools have made it easy to generate everything from images and audio to human-like text. While AI-generated images, videos, and audio can often be identified using dedicated detection tools, AI-written text has largely escaped the same level of scrutiny. ChatGPT, in particular, has become one of the most widely used tools for generating text that can closely mimic human writing. article.title: “There is just not a room for error”: SAP is putting its AI agents in the back office
article.summary: Earlier this year, at its Sapphire conference , SAP outlined its plans for an “Autonomous Enterprise” run in large part by AI agents. This week at Connect in Las Vegas, the company is focusing on how it is actually putting those agents in front of business users. While Sapphire caters to IT, Connect targets the line-of-business practitioners who run finance, procurement, HR, and supply chain operations day to day. Eric van Rossum, SAP’s head of product marketing for applications and suite, tells The New Stack , “Connect is all about making it real. We set the strategy at Sapphire. article.title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
article.summary: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.

article.title: The CNCF is graduating projects faster than ever. AI agents are helping with the due diligence.
article.summary: Back in 2018, a scrappy startup called OpenAI used Kubernetes to balance compute loads across its own data centers and AWS and Azure capacity.
